title: USB Violations Reporting
purpose: Cross-provider sanitized inputs for validating the governed weekly USB Violations report-composer behavior.

interaction_expectation.start_posture: Treat the CSV as USB violations reporting input and remain in the narrow report-composer workflow.
interaction_expectation.clarification_behavior: Ask only bounded questions required by the governed contract. The fixtures intentionally do not provide the previous week's single overall USB violation count.
forbidden_generic_posture: recommendations instead of the requested report
interaction_expectation.final_output_requirement: Construct the governed recipient, subject, and message-draft output rather than merely describing or mentioning it.

privacy.serial_number_handling: Retained from the operator-provided source under explicit operator approval for this test context.
privacy.notes: Do not replace these sanitized fixtures with raw operator data in committed test artifacts.

provenance.note: Derived from an operator-provided violations.csv structure. Direct identifying fields and ticket identifiers were replaced with synthetic values before repository storage.

evidence_boundary.live_evidence_rule: Runtime behavior claims require captured execution evidence tied to the tested target/version/head.
